cases.expected: the same BarSeries instance that the delegate returns
cases.description: Normal case: NumericIndicator is created with a non‑null delegate whose getBarSeries() returns a concrete BarSeries. The test verifies that NumericIndicator.getBarSeries() returns exactly that BarSeries instance.
Edge case: delegate is a mock that returns null from getBarSeries(). The test ensures that NumericIndicator.getBarSeries() propagates the null value without throwing an exception.

cases.expected: the same BarSeries instance on successive calls (reference equality)
cases.description: Idempotence: after constructing NumericIndicator with a delegate that returns a concrete BarSeries, invoke getBarSeries() multiple times and verify each call returns the exact same instance (==).

cases.expected: different BarSeries instances if the delegate returns a new instance each call
cases.description: Dynamic delegate: mock the delegate so that getBarSeries() returns a new BarSeries object on each invocation. Verify that NumericIndicator.getBarSeries() forwards the call and returns the new instance each time (no caching).

Exception propagation: configure the delegate to throw a RuntimeException when getBarSeries() is invoked. Ensure NumericIndicator.getBarSeries() does not catch the exception and the same exception bubbles up to the caller.

cases.expected: the returned BarSeries reflects mutations performed on the original series
cases.description: Live reference: obtain the BarSeries from NumericIndicator, then add a new Bar to the underlying series (through the original BarSeries reference). After the mutation, call getBarSeries() again and verify the returned series contains the added Bar, confirming that the reference is not a copy.

Exception scenario: NumericIndicator is instantiated with a null delegate. Invoking getBarSeries() should throw a NullPointerException because the method attempts to call delegate.getBarSeries() on a null reference.

input.value: mock that throws IllegalArgumentException when getBarSeries() is called

cases.description: Exception propagation: the delegate's getBarSeries() method is configured to throw an IllegalArgumentException. NumericIndicator.getBarSeries() must not catch it and should let the same IllegalArgumentException bubble up to the caller.

input.value: mock that throws AssertionError when getBarSeries() is called

cases.description: Error propagation: the delegate throws an AssertionError (an Error, not an Exception). NumericIndicator.getBarSeries() should propagate this Error unchanged, confirming that no catch‑all handling interferes with Errors.
